answer: The haven graph is validated at intake and the whisper frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and summit anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 318 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. A 319 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
